content: An in-depth analysis of these elements reveals significant transformations in how mining houses structure their external partnerships and manage third-party service providers. Concurrently, the sector has witnessed a fundamental strategic evolution from traditional ownership-focused operations to flow-control-focused operational models [39] . By relinquishing direct ownership of certain peripheral assets and focusing instead on controlling the flow of operations, mining entities naturally increase their reliance on outsourced service providers. Environmental, Social, and Governance considerations have also emerged as a dominant force influencing outsourcing decisions in recent years [7] .
